description: When I think about what truly makes a neighborhood thrive, I don’t just see buildings or streets. I see people. I see connections. I see a community that stands together, fights for fairness, and builds a future where everyone belongs. That’s exactly what we’re doing with CruzNYC. We’re not waiting for change to happen.
